question: According to the WHO 2007 Health System Building Blocks framework, 'Health Information' is one of the six core building blocks of any health system.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is TRUE. Health Information Systems is explicitly one of the six WHO building blocks. A functional health system requires robust data for planning, monitoring, and evaluation — without it, the other five blocks cannot be effectively coordinated.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The WHO framework identifies six building blocks: Service Delivery, Health Workforce, Health Information Systems, Medical Products (medicines/vaccines/technologies), Financing, and Leadership/Governance. Health Information is the third block.
